summary.text: NBU SERVICE AS is a private limited company registered in Årnes, founded 2021-11-03. NBU SERVICE AS is registered for construction of buildings, building and carpentry work both indoors and outdoors, and buying and selling materials. Its registered activities also include other business services not elsewhere classified, participation in other companies with similar activities, buying and selling shares, and annual inspection of buildings, installations and machinery, repair, and buying and selling. It was previously named BILPLEIE KLINIKK BERGEN AS until 2022-11-18. Its main industry code is 41.000: construction of residential and non-residential buildings. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 816 212 NOK and the annual result was 431 271 NOK; operating income was down from 1 031 000 NOK in 2024. The annual result rose from -134 340 NOK in 2024 to 431 271 NOK in 2025. Equity rose from -83 730 NOK in 2024 to 347 541 NOK in 2025. Registered leadership: Donatas Guzauskas (daglig leder and styrets leder). Recent changes in the register: business address set to Lupinsvingen 22 on 2026-05-13.
